events.title: Edgewell Personal Care (EPC) Q2 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates
events.body: Edgewell Personal (EPC) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +39.54% and +0.63%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

events.title: Kraft Heinz's Q1 Earnings on Deck: Key Factors You Should Understand
events.body: KHC heads into first-quarter earnings with sales and profit seen falling as weak demand, inflation and higher marketing spend weigh on near-term performance.

events.title: Will Celsius Holdings Stock Extend Its Earnings Beat Streak in Q1?
events.body: CELH eyes Q1 surge, revenues seen up 129% and EPS up 61% as the PepsiCo partnership, new products and marketing fuel demand.

events.title: Coty's Q3 Earnings on Deck: Key Factors You Should Understand
events.body: COTY's fiscal third-quarter results are likely to show sales and profit declines as weak Consumer Beauty demand and margin pressure weigh on performance.
